data.title: Mizolastine
data.summary: Antihistamines · Second-generation H1 antihistamine — benzimidazole derivative with anti-inflammatory activity
data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Antihistamines_

**Class:** Second-generation H1 antihistamine — benzimidazole derivative with anti-inflammatory activity

## Mechanism of action
- Selective H1 antagonist; also inhibits 5-lipoxygenase (leukotriene) production

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Chronic urticaria, allergic rhinitis

## Dose & formulations
- 10 mg once daily

## Adverse effects
- Drowsiness, dry mouth, weight gain; QT prolongation (cardiac caution)

## Contraindications
- Long QT, significant heart disease, hypokalaemia; with macrolides or azoles

## Drug interactions
- CYP3A4 inhibitors (erythromycin, ketoconazole) — contraindicated together

## Pregnancy & lactation
Avoid.

## Viva points
- Antihistamine + anti-leukotriene action; QT warning

_Sources: Khopkar (Second generation H1 antihistamines). Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
